answer.rationale: Incumbent refused to reopen price, so renew/negotiate cannot hit the 18% cut. Deferral or add-second-source alone leaves the non-auto-renewing primary contract dark in 14 days against a 94% line with no buffer, which raises delivery risk. The low-cost quote is the only path that meets the spend mandate; c2 claims a prior primary move to that vendor had quick onboarding and clean invoicing, which is the only inherited evidence that a switch would not increase delivery risk. Verifying c2 before commit. c1 still implies incumbent continuity is the safer integration path, so scale stays below broad rollout and downstream assembly-risk is flagged.
